subject: ONE round tawny female owl in tiny reading glasses and a knitted shawl, huge amber eyes, head that swivels a full half-turn, never held in one pose
second_characters: A SWARM of identical brown parcels and TWO couriers in green caps hurling parcels across the lens in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE giant glowing tablet with a plain blue screen lying on a heap of parcels; ONE mountain of identical brown parcels around her
props.small: TEN identical white kettles; A SWARM of packing foam peanuts

environment: a cosy cluttered flat at noon, shelves, plants, parcels piled to the ceiling, no empty wall
lighting: bright warm noon sunlight flooding the room; at 5.60 sunlight glints off the bursting foam
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the owl fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, her face never under a quarter of it; from 7.70 her head alone fills the frame centre. She stays on her heap, but her head, wings and feathers never stop. Parcels, kettles and foam peanuts hurl across the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, speech beats too. The camera sways close, never parks, new shot size every beat. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: dry low female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.60, then the parcels and couriers carry it
audio.lip_sync: the owl herself speaks, beak opening on every syllable, brows and eyes alive
audio.pronunciation: RAN-she DU-ma-la, chem BOL-she VY-bor, tem LUCH-she. te-PER ZNA-yu, E-to PUT k HA-o-su

timeline.a: chest-up, from the very first frame her head swivels a full half-turn back and forth like a radar over TEN identical white kettles lined up in a row on the parcels before her, beak working, kettles whipping across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, beak working, she jabs the tablet with one wing tip and it chimes, a parcel hurling across the lens
parcels pelt her from every side, she ducks and flaps, the couriers hurling parcels across the lens

timeline.line: Теперь знаю, это путь к хаосу.
timeline.a: waist-up, facing the lens, beak working, she shoves parcels off her heap with both wings, feathers fluffed, foam peanuts sweeping across the lens
a parcel bursts on her head and foam peanuts erupt over her, she shakes them off, parcels tearing across the lens
parcels pile up to her chest, she flaps hard to stay on top, a courier whipping across the lens
she tears open ONE parcel with her beak and pulls out an eleventh identical white kettle, kettles flying across the lens
she hurls the kettle away and the parcels bury her up to her neck, foam peanuts raking across the lens
only her head pokes out of the parcel mountain, it swivels to one side, eyes on more parcels raining down at the frame edge
her head swivels back to the lens, a flat stare through crooked glasses, she blinks once, ONE foam peanut sliding off her beak

must_appear: 0.00 the owl's head swivelling over a row of TEN identical kettles; 2.10 she taps the tablet; 7.00 the eleventh identical kettle; 9.20 only her head above the parcels, flat stare at the lens
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a conveyor belt, a parked camera, a still or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a closed beak while speaking, offscreen narration, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.60, English speech, foreign accent, a male voice, a second owl
